name: Raj Patel

resumeText: Raj Patel is a Senior Data Engineer at Meridian Analytics with nine years of experience in data engineering. He owns batch and streaming pipelines powered by Apache Spark and Airflow, designs dimensional models in BigQuery, and drives infrastructure-as-code with Terraform and Kubernetes. He partners closely with analytics and ML teams to keep data accurate, fresh, and well-documented.
